'''R9-D9''' was the personal [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. R9-D9 showed [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images of [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] and [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], members of the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].
